pattern: ようによっては / ようでは
aliases: you ni yotte wa / you dewa
purpose: Make an evaluation depend on how something is done or viewed.
keywords: Vます stem + ようによっては / ようでは
Depending on how you look at it, the cloud looks like a bird.
Depending on how it is used, even an old box can be useful.
Depending on how it is phrased, the same content can sound rude.
formation: Vます stem + ようによっては / ようでは
restrictions: Often with 見る, 考える, 使う, or 言う.
mistake: よう here means manner; it is not the volitional ending.
